versos.grego: Μὴ πολλοὶ διδάσκαλοι γίνεσθε, ἀδελφοί μου, εἰδότες ὅτι μεῖζον κρίμα λημψόμεθα.

controles.web: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
controles.kjv: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
controles.livre: Meus irmãos, não sejais muitos de vós mestres, porque sabeis que receberemos um julgamento mais rigoroso.

versos.grego: πολλὰ γὰρ πταίομεν ἅπαντες· εἴ τις ἐν λόγῳ οὐ πταίει, οὗτος τέλειος ἀνήρ, δυνατὸς χαλιναγωγῆσαι καὶ ὅλον τὸ σῶμα.

controles.web: For in many things we all stumble. If anyone doesn’t stumble in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.
controles.kjv: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
controles.livre: Pois todos tropeçamos em muitas coisas. Se alguém não tropeça no que diz, tal homem é completo,  e também capaz de refrear todo o corpo.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ τῶν ἵππων τοὺς χαλινοὺς εἰς τὰ στόματα βάλλομεν εἰς τὸ πείθεσθαι αὐτοὺς ἡμῖν, καὶ ὅλον τὸ σῶμα αὐτῶν μετάγομεν.

controles.web: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
controles.kjv: Behold, we put bits in the horses’ mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
controles.livre: Ora, pomos freios nas bocas dos cavalos para nos obedecerem, e assim manobramos todo o corpo deles.

versos.grego: ἰδοὺ καὶ τὰ πλοῖα, τηλικαῦτα ὄντα καὶ ὑπὸ ἀνέμων σκληρῶν ἐλαυνόμενα, μετάγεται ὑπὸ ἐλαχίστου πηδαλίου ὅπου ἡ ὁρμὴ τοῦ εὐθύνοντος βούλεται·

controles.web: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
controles.kjv: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
controles.livre: Vede também os navios, sendo tão grandes, e levados por impetuosos ventos, são manobrados com um pequeníssimo leme para onde quer que queira o impulso daquele que dirige.

versos.grego: οὕτως καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα μικρὸν μέλος ἐστὶν καὶ μεγάλα αὐχεῖ. ἰδοὺ ἡλίκον πῦρ ἡλίκην ὕλην ἀνάπτει·

controles.web: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
controles.kjv: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
controles.livre: Assim também a língua é um pequeno membro, mas se orgulha de grandes coisas. Vede como um pequeno fogo incendeia um grande bosque!

versos.grego: καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα πῦρ, ὁ κόσμος τῆς ἀδικίας, ἡ γλῶσσα καθίσταται ἐν τοῖς μέλεσιν ἡμῶν, ἡ σπιλοῦσα ὅλον τὸ σῶμα καὶ φλογίζουσα τὸν τροχὸν τῆς γενέσεως καὶ φλογιζομένη ὑπὸ τῆς γεέννης.

controles.web: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
controles.kjv: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
controles.livre: A língua também é um fogo, o mundo da injustiça; a língua está posta entre os nossos membros, contaminando o corpo todo, inflamando o curso da natureza humana, e sendo inflamada pelo inferno.

versos.grego: πᾶσα γὰρ φύσις θηρίων τε καὶ πετεινῶν ἑρπετῶν τε καὶ ἐναλίων δαμάζεται καὶ δεδάμασται τῇ φύσει τῇ ἀνθρωπίνῃ,

controles.web: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and thing in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind.
controles.kjv: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
controles.livre: Pois toda espécie, tanto de animais selvagens como de aves, tanto de répteis como de animais marinhos, é dominível e tem sido dominada pela espécie humana;

versos.grego: τὴν δὲ γλῶσσαν οὐδεὶς δαμάσαι δύναται ἀνθρώπων· ἀκατάστατον κακόν, μεστὴ ἰοῦ θανατηφόρου.

controles.web: But nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
controles.kjv: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
controles.livre: Mas nenhum ser humano consegue dominar a língua; ela é um mal que não se cansa, cheia de veneno mortal.

versos.grego: ἐν αὐτῇ εὐλογοῦμεν τὸν Κύριον καὶ Πατέρα, καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ καταρώμεθα τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τοὺς καθ’ ὁμοίωσιν Θεοῦ γεγονότας·

controles.web: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, who are made in the image of God.
controles.kjv: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
controles.livre: Com ela bendizemos o Deus e Pai, e com ela amaldiçoamos os seres humanos, que são feitos à semelhança de Deus.

versos.grego: ἐκ τοῦ αὐτοῦ στόματος ἐξέρχεται εὐλογία καὶ κατάρα. οὐ χρή, ἀδελφοί μου, ταῦτα οὕτως γίνεσθαι.

controles.web: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
controles.kjv: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
controles.livre: Da mesma boca procedem benção e maldição. Meus irmãos, isso não deve ser assim.

versos.grego: μήτι ἡ πηγὴ ἐκ τῆς αὐτῆς ὀπῆς βρύει τὸ γλυκὺ καὶ τὸ πικρόν;

controles.web: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
controles.kjv: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
controles.livre: Acaso uma fonte jorra do mesmo manancial água doce e água amarga?

versos.grego: μὴ δύναται, ἀδελφοί μου, συκῆ ἐλαίας ποιῆσαι ἢ ἄμπελος σῦκα; οὔτε ἁλυκὸν γλυκὺ ποιῆσαι ὕδωρ.

controles.web: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
controles.kjv: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
controles.livre: Meus irmãos, pode a figueira dar azeitonas, ou a videira figos? E nenhuma fonte dá tanto água salgada como doce.

versos.grego: Τίς σοφὸς καὶ ἐπιστήμων ἐν ὑμῖν; δειξάτω ἐκ τῆς καλῆς ἀναστροφῆς τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐν πραΰτητι σοφίας.

controles.web: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
controles.kjv: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
controles.livre: Quem dentre vós for sábio e inteligente, que mostre pela boa conduta as suas obras em humildade de sabedoria.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ζῆλον πικρὸν ἔχετε καὶ ἐριθείαν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν, μὴ κατακαυχᾶσθε καὶ ψεύδεσθε κατὰ τῆς ἀληθείας.

controles.web: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
controles.kjv: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
controles.livre: Porém, se tendes amarga inveja e rivalidade no vosso coração, não vos orgulheis, nem mintais contra a verdade.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔστιν αὕτη ἡ σοφία ἄνωθεν κατερχομένη, ἀλλὰ ἐπίγειος, ψυχική, δαιμονιώδης·

controles.web: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
controles.kjv: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
controles.livre: Esta sabedoria não é a que vem do alto, mas sim, terrena, animal, e demoníaca.

versos.grego: ὅπου γὰρ ζῆλος καὶ ἐριθεία, ἐκεῖ ἀκαταστασία καὶ πᾶν φαῦλον πρᾶγμα.

controles.web: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
controles.kjv: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
controles.livre: Pois onde há inveja e rivalidade, ali há perturbação e toda obra perversa.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ ἄνωθεν σοφία πρῶτον μὲν ἁγνή ἐστιν, ἔπειτα εἰρηνική, ἐπιεικής, εὐπειθής, μεστὴ ἐλέους καὶ καρπῶν ἀγαθῶν, ἀδιάκριτος, ἀνυπόκριτος.

controles.web: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
controles.kjv: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
controles.livre: Mas a sabedoria do alto é primeiramente pura, depois pacífica, moderada, tratável, cheia de misericórdia e de bons frutos, imparcial e sem hipocrisia.

versos.grego: καρπὸς δὲ δικαιοσύνης ἐν εἰρήνῃ σπείρεται τοῖς ποιοῦσιν εἰρήνην.

controles.web: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
controles.kjv: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
controles.livre: E o fruto da justiça é semeado na paz para os que praticam a paz.
